title: Tune the Settings line and its scroll fade

steps.path: Scroll inside Settings to test; scroll outside the pane for other versions
steps.hint: Scroll down and back up inside each Settings drawer; then scroll this comparison area outside the pane for the next version.
steps.headline: Scroll each drawer down and back up before choosing the title line.
steps.risk: All three keep today's animated top scroll fade. This picks the line's ends, not the final guide rule or the fade treatment.

variants.label: Quick ends
variants.summary: Reaches a solid line quickly, then stays steady through most of the header.
variants.risk: Could read as nearly full-width again.

variants.label: Moderate ends
variants.summary: A moderate fade at both ends, between the quick and gradual versions.
variants.risk: Still may clash with the fade that appears above scrolled content.

variants.label: Gradual ends
variants.summary: Fades toward the middle for longer; the solid center is shorter.
variants.risk: May disappear on patterned or pale themes.

steps.path: Scroll inside Settings to test; scroll outside the pane for other versions
steps.hint: Scroll down and back up inside each Settings drawer; then scroll this comparison area outside the pane for the next version.
steps.headline: Scroll each drawer down and back up. Which top-edge motion feels right?
steps.risk: Each pane uses the same moderate line for a fair fade comparison. Your line choice above will be combined with this choice in a later check. The bottom fade is unchanged.

variants.label: Current fade
variants.summary: A full-strength top gradient appears in 150ms once content moves under the header.
variants.risk: Its full-width colour band may fight the tapered line, especially on wallpapers.

variants.label: Softer fade
variants.summary: The same top gradient at 45% strength, arriving and leaving over 220ms.
variants.risk: Could be too subtle as a clue that more settings are above.

variants.label: No top fade
variants.summary: Only the title line marks the top. The bottom keeps its current gradient.
variants.risk: Without the top clue, hidden settings above may be less obvious.
